versions.changelog: 版本跃迁至 2.0.0，多项功能更新与优化
新增「星穹漫影」风格 (原神/崩铁质感)，优化二次元出图 Prompt 结构，提升精致度与细节表现。
气质升级，吸收'光笺'风格，新增浮光速写、月影绘本、植语水彩三种模式，优化文案交互逻辑。

Version 1.0.0 of "风语绘 (Whisper Sketch)" released.  
Generate high-quality “Resonant Quote Card” illustrations blending hand-drawn style with emotionally resonant text, ideal for WeChat/Xiaohongshu.

- Introduced 3 core illustration styles: Fashion Sketch, Jimmy's Storybook, Fresh Watercolor, plus user-customizable options.
- AI intelligently selects the art style based on user input and emotional tone, or locks in user-specified styles.
- Interactive workflow: suggest three matching text options tailored to style and theme.
- Generates image prompts with dynamic text placement and style-appropriate keywords.
- Promotes harmony between visuals and handwritten text through creative composition.
